item.title: Re: Staff Post - Open
item.content:encoded: My bad. I didn't know it just straight-up changed the text- I thought the changes went to the original author for review. I'll read up on the required protocol again if I ever decide to edit an article.

item.title: Staff Post - Open
item.content:encoded:
Kean Gilbert, the changes that you've made were heavily substantial, and often changed the meaning of some of the sentences. Furthermore, there doesn't seem to be any indication of the author having given permission for the changes; as such, they've been reverted.

Please contact the original poster and/or a staff member prior to making major edits. In the meantime, staff will review the changes you've made and decide which ones to keep.
